summary: Validated SHA-256 declarations, overflow-safe chunk counts, exact chunk boundaries, and terminal upload lifecycle transitions.
Made accepted chunk files immutable under competing uploads, preserved identical retries, bounded oversized input reads, and isolated assembled-stream temporary files.
Checked actual assembled length and checksum before blob or database graph writes; added a pure, overflow-safe quota preflight before external storage.
Repaired the FileNode.Versions EF relationship mapping conflict exposed by actual context-model initialization.
Added domain, real-filesystem, and fresh-context handler regressions; the final project suite passed all 22 tests.
Added nine source-based guide chapters with worked traces, exercises, solutions, exact original snapshots, and recorded verification evidence.

checks.command: Recorded test runs and build/type checks

limits: Handler persistence tests use EF InMemory with fake external storage and queue ports; they do not establish SQL uniqueness, rollback, or concurrent database isolation.
Filesystem concurrency tests use real temporary files on this Windows host. API-host, frontend, and deployed end-to-end checks were not part of the accepted test command.

Blob persistence, database commit, and subsequent queue notification remain separate resource boundaries. No unsafe shared-blob deletion compensation was added; durable recovery requires its own protocol.
